name: OA Table 39: Ancestry
description: Roll the die type, the number of times, given by OA Table 38 for the character's birth rank (for example d6 once for Outcast). The table's own formula is 1d100 so that every row can be reached; change the formula to the die from Table 38 before rolling, or roll that die and look up the result. Honor found here is added to the family honor from Table 38. Each result is explained in the OA Journals, Family and Honor (OA p.33-34).
